The '''Battle of Omwat''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omwat/Legends|Omwat]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Footage from the battle was sent via [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holo-transmitter]] to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].
